mapper.select: SELECT CAST(COALESCE(paid_at, created_at) AS DATE) AS biz_date, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM `order` WHERE shop_id=#{shopId} AND region=#{region} AND pay_status=1 AND CAST(COALESCE(paid_at, created_at) AS DATE) BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY CAST(COALESCE(paid_at, created_at) AS DATE)
